test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate indirect form of the given sentence.**

Mary says, “My younger brother wants to be a radio jockey.”

options.text: Mary says that her younger brother wants to be a radio jockey.
Mary says that my younger brother wanted to be a radio jockey.
Mary said that her younger brother wanted to be a radio jockey.
Mary says that my younger brother wants to be a radio jockey.

solution:
The correct answer is '**Mary says that her younger brother wants to be a radio jockey**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• It is clear that the **given sentence is in the present tense** so the **changes will be limited**.
 
• To convert from direct to indirect speech, there are some basic rules that we need to follow:
 
 
• Inverted commas (,") needs to be removed and use 'that' in the same place.
 
 
 
• The subject of the Reported speech (**My younger brother)** has to be changed according to the Subject of Reporting speech (Mary says).
 
 
• The subject 'My younger brother' into 'her younger brother'.
 
 
 
• If we follow the above changes, the indirect speech would be:
 
 
• *Mary says **that her**__ younger brother wants to be a radio jockey.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is ​option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__**Let's understand the same concept with different examples:**

__
 
• He says, "my father is working in a big firm."
 
 
• *He says **that his father__** is working in a big firm.*
 
 
 
• She says, "my aunt is very helpful."
 __
 
• *She says **that her aunt**__ is very helpful.*
